description: Air Cargo Discharged By Region/Country Of Origin, Monthly is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Singapore Department of Statistics. Source: CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE Data Last Updated: 29/08/2025 Update Frequency: Monthly Footnotes: Refers to Changi Airport only. Data exclude passenger baggage, diplomatic cargo and aircraft stores. Data breakdown is only available for the 11 countries listed above, and they do not sum up to the total of the respective regions. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Singapore Department of Statistics. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
